Subject: Parachute Health POC: success hypotheses & environment decision

Thanks again for the demo today — really appreciated the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a short POC kicked off next week.

High-level success hypotheses (what Parachute will validate):
- Accuracy and relevance: redwood responses align with Parachute’s clinical Q&A tests (baseline > 85% pass on our shared prompt set).
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency for single-turn queries < 300ms (for hosted sandbox) and < 200ms once on dedicated capacity.
- Cost: target token cost that keeps forecasted monthly cost under $X (we'll refine after initial run).
- Data controls: end-to-end audit trail and retention controls meet your SOC2 & HIPAA review expectations.

POC proposal (two phases):
1) Quick validation (2 weeks): hosted sandbox with synthetic/anonymized data to validate accuracy and initial latency/cost metrics. Deliverables: shared prompt evaluation, per-route latency/cost snapshot, short findings doc.
2) Production mimic (2–4 weeks): move to either dedicated sandbox or VPC trial depending on your security needs. Deliverables: load/throughput run, KV-cache behavior, audit logs + network checklist.

Decision needed from your side: prefer to start with hosted sandbox (fastest) or go straight to VPC trial (longer lead time but full data isolation)? We can also recommend dedicated sandbox as a middle ground — isolated capacity but lighter network setup.

Owners / next steps:
- Ben (me): coordinate kickoff, demo scripts, MRP for evaluation.
- Marissa: infra checklist and environment lead.
- Karthik: success criteria and prompt-set instrumentation.
- Monica: onboarding and billing/contract questions.

Attachments: POC-success-hypotheses.xlsx (working draft), network-requirements-stub.pdf

Can you confirm preferred environment and available times for a short technical kickoff (30–45m) next week? Suggested windows: Tue 12/22 10–12 PT or Wed 12/23 14–16 PT.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of follow-ups from our security and engineering side: 

- We need to validate that PHI will not leave our VPC in the production mimic phase; does Redwood support a full VPC option with customer-managed keys?
- For the quick validation, can we run the hosted sandbox strictly on synthetic/anonymized data and ensure no logs persist beyond the POC window? We will want a statement on data retention for that sandbox.
- Timeline: we like the two-phase approach. If the hosted sandbox can be ready within 48–72 hours, we prefer that to unblock model validation. VPC will be our target for production mimic week 3–4.

Also — can you send an example network ports list and an outline of certificate/key rotation policies for the VPC option? We will need that for our infra review.

Thanks,
Sarah

sarah.liu@parachutehealth.com | +1 617-555-0142

Thanks Sarah — great questions. Quick answers inline, and Marissa will follow up with the detailed checklist and lead times.

- VPC option: yes, we support a Private deployment that can be customer VPC with KMS integration. For the POC we can mirror production traffic patterns in that environment; we'll provide the KMS/HSM integration notes.
- Hosted sandbox retention: we can configure the sandbox to purge logs after the POC window and limit retention to X days. I will get a formal retention statement from our compliance team.
- Timeline: we can usually spin up a hosted sandbox with synthetic data in 48–72 hours assuming a signed SOW or acceptance of our standard POC terms. VPC setup typically takes 2–3 weeks (depending on networking approvals).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- By Wed 12/22: kickoff tech call & delivery of synthetic prompt set (owner: Ben).
- By Fri 12/24: hosted sandbox provisioned and sample evaluation run (owner: Marissa).
- Week of 1/4: pivot to VPC/dedicated sandbox kickoff (owner: Marissa/Karthik).

Marissa — can you attach the one-page VPC checklist and note which items usually take the most time from customers? Karthik — can you start instrumenting the prompt set so we can capture the pass rate and latency metrics? Monica — I'll loop you for the SOW/POC billing note.

Ben

Hi all — attaching a short checklist and a note about typical lead times. See attachment: network-requirements-stub.pdf (lightweight summary) and below highlights: 

Quick guidance:
- Hosted sandbox (fastest): 48–72 hours to provision. Best for initial accuracy/latency checks with synthetic data. We can restrict retention and disable external logging.
- Dedicated sandbox (isolated capacity): 3–5 business days to reserve capacity and configure. Gives isolation for throughput testing without full VPC networking. No tenant co-mingling.
- VPC trial (customer-managed networking): 10–21 business days depending on your FW/peering approvals. Requires cert exchange, IP allowlists, and IAM/KMS coordination.

Common VPC items that cause delay: network peering approvals, corporate firewall rules, and KMS integration paperwork. If you can pre-approve IP ranges and provide a point-of-contact for networking, that accelerates the process.

Marissa Cole | Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
